questions.label: Random weekend text
questions.prompt: A friend randomly texts you on a Saturday. You...

options.label: Drop everything and meet them in an hour
Hop on a long voice call to catch up properly
Suggest a specific day next week to hang out
Reply warmly, share a thought, promise to follow up

questions.label: Bad news
questions.prompt: A friend tells you they're going through a hard time.

options.label: Show up at their door within the hour
Call them right away and just listen
Send a small care package and a note
Set up a recurring check-in over the next weeks

questions.label: Group hangout
questions.prompt: When the group hangs out, what's your role?

options.label: The one who organized it and keeps it moving
The quiet one in the corner everyone checks in with
The one with the story that turns into a second hangout
The one making sure everyone has a ride home
Something specific they mentioned once, three months ago
An experience you can do together
Something handmade or personal
Something funny that only they would get

questions.label: Friend moves away
questions.prompt: A close friend moves to another city. You...

options.label: Schedule weekly video calls and stick to them
Plan to visit them within the next few months
Commit to handwritten letters
Let the rhythm find itself; reach out when it feels right

questions.label: Big personal news
questions.prompt: Your friend just got engaged. Your first instinct?

options.label: Cry happy tears in person as fast as possible
Start planning how you'll celebrate
Pull them aside for a long talk about how they feel
Send a long, heartfelt message they can re-read

questions.label: Friend disagreement
questions.prompt: You and a close friend disagree about something they care about.

options.label: Say it clearly; honesty is the bedrock
Pick your battles; let it go this time
Ask good questions until they hear themselves
Yield; this matters more to them than to you

questions.label: Friendship energy
questions.prompt: Honest check-in: how are you at showing up for friends lately?

options.label: Very on — I reach out before they do
Balanced — give and take, mostly even
Tired — I want to, but my tank is low
Thinking about who I want to be closer to

questions.label: A friend's secret
questions.prompt: A friend tells you something they've never told anyone else.

options.label: Vault it forever, never speak of it again
Hold it, then quietly check on them about it later
Honor it by living like you know — without saying
Thank them for trusting you with it

archetypes.label: The Ride-or-Die
archetypes.tagline: Loyal, present, and the first one at the door when it matters.
archetypes.blind-spot: Loyalty can crowd out the friend you haven't met yet.

archetypes.label: The Confidant
archetypes.tagline: Deep, careful, and trusted with the things no one else hears.
archetypes.blind-spot: Holding space for everyone can quietly empty your own.

archetypes.label: The Spark
archetypes.tagline: High energy, big plans, and the reason the group showed up tonight.
archetypes.blind-spot: Energy can outpace follow-through when the moment passes.

archetypes.label: The Warm Presence
archetypes.tagline: Steady warmth, easy to be around, the room feels safer with you in it.
archetypes.blind-spot: Quiet can be mistaken for passive when actually showing up is what you do.

archetypes.label: The Memory Keeper
archetypes.tagline: You remember the small things and surface them at exactly the right time.
archetypes.blind-spot: Memory can become a way of holding on tighter than is healthy.

archetypes.label: The Playmaker
archetypes.tagline: You turn ordinary Tuesdays into stories people retell.
archetypes.blind-spot: The spotlight can crowd out the quieter friend who needs you most.
